newsitem.title: USA: Viatel extends European net to 21 cities.
newsitem.headline: Viatel extends European net to 21 cities.

text.p: Viatel Inc said Monday it added new "points of presence" (POP) in Belgium, the Netherlands and Spain, raising to 21 the number of its operational switching and interconnection locations in Europe.
Michael Mahoney, president and chief operating officer of Viatel, said the new POPs were installed ahead of schedule.
"This will allow Viatel to maintain the momentum that has been building over the fist half of 1997 as we approach full deregulagion of voice telephony in Euope in January 1998," he said.
POPs are computer connections that allows a telephone caller to connect to a specific system. The new POPs are located in Leuven, Belgium, the Hague, Netherlands, and Valancia, Spain, Viatel said.
Viatel is an international and domestic long-distance telecommuncations company with network opoerations in seven European countries, the U.S., Latin America and the Pacific Rim.
